phase: A diagnostic about the measurement, not a new candidate. Three runs of v45 at 384 cells gave 356, 326 and 339, a standard deviation of fifteen cells where independent sampling would give six. Something beyond sampling moves between runs, and at a true rate of 88.6 per cent the chance of any run reaching the registered gate of 365 is zero. So the twenty-five cells between v45 and the gate are either a defect the prompt can still fix or the sampling that temperature 0.7 buys. Greedy decoding separates the two. v5 rides along so the prompt gap can be checked at the same setting.
design: Identical frozen persona, synthetic Day0 state and date within each pair. Fiscal arms share environment. Distancing arms differ only in explicitly registered restrictions, not disease background. Read-only Neo4j; no rollout or database reset.
initial_state: 39 times daily_wd cash; mood=0.5, fatigue=0.3, energy=0.7, satisfaction=0.6; no prior memories or appointments. These are simulation initial conditions, not observed personal history.
cashback_seed: Monthly eligible spend seeded as daily weighted anchor * 0.268 * (day_of_month - 1), identically in off/on arms. Policy facts use experiment date as counterfactual start.
attribution_rule: In fiscal off arms flag trigger=policy AND reasoning mentioning P012/P013/P014/cashback/coupon/voucher/grant/local voucher. Environmental regulation attribution is allowed. This is a conservative screening flag, not a validated hallucination classifier; manually inspect flagged text before interpretation.
contract_checks: valid time and strictly increasing >=20 minute spacing
decision: Diagnostic only. No candidate is selected, dropped or promoted from this round. It decides what the remaining twenty-five cells are, and therefore whether the registered gate is a statement about the prompt or about the sampler. If greedy clears 95 per cent, the gate as written is a property of the decoding setting and must be restated before any prompt is judged against it.
inference: 12-person repeated matched-context pilot measures instruction execution and within-person decisions only. No spending outcome, causal macro effect, empirical magnitude score, or fresh holdout generalization claim.
holdout: P015 prohibited; already used. All four mechanisms are known development cases.
magnitude_future: Use simultaneous independent on/off rollouts, same dates and initial snapshots, independent run replicates. Report effect and interval; 0.5-2.0 empirical magnitude only when population, outcome definition, denominator and horizon match. Otherwise mark not comparable.
stop_rule: Run every preregistered cell once; preserve errors and raw outputs. No significance-based early stopping or silent retries. Failure of gate blocks automatic macro rollout.
power: Greedy decoding removes the sampler, so the paired comparison against the 0.7 runs is read cell by cell rather than as a rate difference. No minimum detectable difference is quoted because the question is not the size of a gap but which of two explanations holds: if the residual is sampling, greedy lands near 95 per cent; if it is the prompt, greedy lands near the 88.6 per cent the three runs average.
predicted: Greedy lands between 91 and 95 per cent - above the 88.6 average because sampling at 0.7 costs some compliance, below a clean 95 because the residual categories, the time gap and the zone code, looked systematic when their text was read. So the expectation is that both explanations hold in part. If greedy lands at 88 the residual is entirely the prompt; if it lands at 97 it is entirely the sampler. Either extreme would be a cleaner answer than the one expected.
not_changed: Sample, seeds, dates, cases, arms, token budget, candidates’ text and every contract check are copied from validation_v47. Temperature is the only change.
